clue.text: Cut down church work

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: A church's workforce or its activities are being reduced.
explanation.definitionFit: To chop a tree is to fell it with blows of an axe.

clue.text: Bill born with spots on the face

parts.note: AC (account) is a bill to be paid
NEE means born, as in a maiden name; here shortened to NE

explanation.surface: A man called Bill was born with a spotty face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a person's name but is an account, AC; 'born' is née, here clipped to NE.
explanation.definitionFit: The skin condition of pimples, typical of adolescence, shows as spots on the face.

clue.text: In case Leslie needs time

parts.note: Les is the usual short form of the name Leslie

explanation.surface: Leslie might need extra time, just to be safe.
explanation.definitionFit: The conjunction expresses a precaution, meaning for fear that.

clue.text: Good man heads universal fight to stop cigarette smoking

parts.note: ST (saint) is the crossword's good man
U is the film-certificate abbreviation for universal
a bout is a boxing fight

explanation.surface: A saintly man leads a campaign against smoking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heads' only tells us the saint comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressing the lit end against an ashtray extinguishes a cigarette.

clue.text: Cure a tendency to jerry building

definitions.text: Cure a tendency to jerry building

parts.words: Cure a tendency to jerry building
parts.note: jerry building is shoddy construction; curing it means constructing to a higher standard, and the phrase also means simply to heal

explanation.surface: How to stop builders cutting corners.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'make' as build: building more soundly cures jerry building, and the phrase as a whole means cure.
explanation.definitionFit: To heal or improve something is to restore it; read literally the words say construct to a higher standard.

clue.text: Elegant Lady Stanhope is to be found in Sussex

parts.note: chic means stylish or elegant
Lady Hester Stanhope was a famous nineteenth-century English traveller in the Middle East

explanation.surface: A stylish aristocratic lady can be spotted in the south of England.
explanation.walkthrough: Sussex is a county on England's south coast; the city named is its cathedral city.
explanation.definitionFit: The cathedral city is the county town of West Sussex, so it lies in that county.

clue.text: Barker describes the sinking sun

definitions.meaning: a barker is a dog; this one is an Irish breed of gundog with a chestnut coat
the evening sun is coloured crimson as it goes down, a crimson thing going down

explanation.surface: A barker, perhaps a poet, paints a sunset in words.
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish gundog is a barker; split into its words, the name also pictures the crimson sun going down.

clue.text: Vehemently upbraid Billy

definitions.meaning: to attack someone fiercely in words
a billy is a male of the horned farm animal

explanation.surface: Someone tells off a man called Billy with great force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Billy' poses as a name but is the billy, the male animal.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay into someone is to attack them, and a billy is a male of that bearded farm animal.

clue.text: Well suited partners make for an interesting tennis game

definitions.meaning: a pairing of people who fit together well
an enjoyable contest on court between evenly matched players

explanation.surface: Two compatible people make a lively doubles pairing on court.
explanation.definitionFit: A happy couple is a fine pairing, and an entertaining contest on court is a fine fixture.

clue.text: Situation is poor for picturesque German spa

parts.note: pretty means pleasant to look at, picturesque
Bad is the German word for bath, the prefix of spa towns like Baden-Baden

explanation.surface: Things look grim for a charming spa town in Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: German spa towns carry the prefix Bad (Bad Ems, Bad Homburg).
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something is fairly awful means it is quite poor.

clue.text: To love as well

parts.note: O is love, a zero score in tennis

explanation.surface: A request to love someone in addition.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means also or in addition.

clue.text: Appeal to Turk and do what he says

parts.note: O is the vocative interjection of appeal, as in O Lord
a bey was a Turkish governor or gentleman

explanation.surface: Someone pleads with a Turkish official and then complies with his orders.
explanation.definitionFit: To comply with a command or instruction is to follow it.

clue.text: Piece of earth upset computer filing system

indicators.note: in a down-reading light upset can mean turned over, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: DOS is Disk Operating System, an old computer system that managed files

explanation.surface: Some soil has messed up a computer's file storage.
explanation.definitionFit: A clod of turf with grass and roots is a lump of earth.

clue.text: Persistently request to bring in French article

parts.note: to import goods is to bring them in from abroad
une is the French feminine indefinite article, a

explanation.surface: A demand to start importing a French piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: To pester someone with repeated pleas is to beg them insistently.

clue.text: Where a doctor should be currently skilled

definitions.meaning: a doctor ought to be working in a surgery or medical business
keeping one's skills sharp through recent regular use

explanation.surface: A doctor should be up to date with current techniques.
explanation.definitionFit: A GP's surgery is a medical business, and keeping a skill sharp by regular use is staying trained.

clue.text: Enthusiasm top rep put up for a season?

parts.note: pep is energy or enthusiasm

indicators.note: in a down light put up means written from the bottom upwards, so these words are read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An eager salesman displays his best product ahead of a time of year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' reverses TOPREP to PERPOT. 'season' is a pun: the container is for seasoning food, not a time of year.
explanation.definitionFit: A cruet piece is used to sprinkle spice on food, so it is for seasoning.

clue.text: I restored order? Anything but!

indicators.note: putting letters in a fresh order rearranges them

explanation.surface: Someone protests they brought calm, but the truth is the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' is the anagram signal; the whole clue also describes rowdy revelling, the opposite of restoring order.
explanation.definitionFit: Revelling noisily and boisterously is the very reverse of keeping order.

clue.text: The air in Amiens

indicators.note: the letters are found within the French city name

explanation.surface: The atmosphere in a French city.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's bearing or manner is their look, often called their air.

clue.text: Tax free investment in continent causes indigestion

indicators.note: one word placed within the other

parts.note: Asia is a continent
a PEP, Personal Equity Plan, was a British tax-free investment scheme

explanation.surface: Putting tax-free money into the East upsets one's stomach.
explanation.walkthrough: A PEP was a UK tax-free savings plan of the 1980s and 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: The medical term names a failure of digestion, so it means dyspepsia.

clue.text: Act represented by St Anthony's cross in sculpture

indicators.note: the cross is set inside the sculpture

parts.note: a statue is a sculpted figure
St Anthony's cross is the tau cross, shaped like a capital T

explanation.surface: A sculpted saint holding his cross represents something formal.
explanation.walkthrough: The tau cross associated with St Anthony is T-shaped.
explanation.definitionFit: A law passed by Parliament is called an Act.

clue.text: Black birds and dogs

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
eagles are birds of prey

explanation.surface: Black birds and some hounds.
explanation.definitionFit: The breed is a small hound used for hunting hares.

clue.text: Far Eastern food

parts.note: taken as written; the run of letters across Far Eastern is a coincidence of the charade, not a hidden word

explanation.surface: Cuisine of the Orient.
explanation.definitionFit: Food and drink provided at a meal is the menu or diet served.

clue.text: Chart here is amended to show Sagittarius

indicators.note: a chart that has been amended has been altered, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An astrologer's chart is corrected to show a star sign.
explanation.definitionFit: The constellation and zodiac sign is depicted as a bowman.

clue.text: Bully? No, his mate

parts.note: not the bull itself but the bull's female partner; and the word also means to bully or intimidate

explanation.surface: Is he a bully? No, that's just his friend.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Bully' as bull-y: not the bull but his partner. The same word as a verb means to intimidate.
explanation.definitionFit: The female partner of a bull is this farm animal, and as a verb the word means intimidate.

clue.text: A grain port

definitions.meaning: a cereal crop used for bread and whisky
a small town in East Sussex, once a Cinque Port

explanation.surface: A cereal and a harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: The cereal is used for bread and whiskey, and the Sussex town of that name was an ancient harbour.

clue.text: Plug up a set of pipes

definitions.meaning: to block or seal a hole
on an organ, a rank of pipes controlled by one knob

explanation.surface: Seal off some plumbing.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'set of pipes' is part of an organ, not plumbing.
explanation.definitionFit: To block a hole is to seal it, and an organ's knob-controlled rank of pipes shares the name.

clue.text: Tories draw back from the Left

parts.note: the Tories are the political Right

indicators.note: drawing back means the word is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Conservatives pull away from the socialists.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving away from the Left means heading towards the other side, the political or literal right.

clue.text: Shop but count the money

definitions.meaning: to inform on someone to the police
to count money, as a bank teller does

explanation.surface: A shop where the takings are tallied.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shop' is the British slang verb for informing on someone; 'but' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: To grass on someone is to inform, and a bank teller's job is to count cash.

clue.text: Scraps of a different sort

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Scraps of a different sort' (4) clues ORTS (anagram of sort), but the grid answer is ARTS, its A confirmed by crossing 25-across RIGHTWARD; clue and answer disagree

clue.text: An action one can look up to

indicators.note: in a down light, reading upwards gives the same word, a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A heroic act that people admire.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests admiration, but 'look up' means read the down light from the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: A deed is something done, a feat.

clue.text: Tax gas emitted by cars in the street

indicators.note: the gas is placed inside the street

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street
CO is carbon monoxide, a gas in car exhaust

explanation.surface: Fuel duty on exhaust fumes in town.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a levy or payment, as in getting off scot-free.

clue.text: Battery hen house apparently needs thorough clearing out

definitions.text: Battery hen house apparently needs thorough clearing out

parts.words: Battery hen house apparently needs thorough clearing out
parts.note: a henhouse full of muck would seem to need a thorough mucking out; the phrase is really a poultry-keeping system with a thick bedding layer

explanation.surface: A crowded henhouse is filthy and needs a good clean.
explanation.walkthrough: Deep litter is a system of keeping hens on thick straw bedding, the alternative to battery cages.
explanation.definitionFit: A housing method for poultry on thick bedding reads literally as a thick layer of rubbish.
